name: Noah
label: Lossless seeker on Tidal
who: I mostly listen through Tidal for lossless audio and keep Spotify for discovery and Spotify Connect. I listen on a capable setup, including headphones and in the car, and I care about audio quality and whether artists are paid fairly.
value_for_money: Says Tidal pays artists more per stream than Spotify and that Spotify HiFi would be worth paying extra for; notes that competitors offer lossless at similar or lower prices while Spotify does not.
loyalty: Spotify Connect and its recommendation engine keep them on Spotify; lossless quality and fairer artist payouts are why they use Tidal, and they have said the Spotify UI is a reason they left.
pain_points: Tidal's app can be buggy and has a smaller catalog for some artists
Spotify pays artists less than Tidal
tone: Detailed and opinionated, comparing features and audio quality with sincere frustration.
